bukti: The review examines core components of non-destructive imaging-based monitoring systems in vineyards, focusing on sensors, tasks, and data processing methodologies.
the most widespread analysis focuses on grape bunches, as they provide information on both the quality and quantity of the harvest
catatan: Tinjauan pemantauan berbasis citra di kebun anggur; analisis tandan anggur untuk kuantitas panen dinyatakan sebagai tugas yang paling banyak dikaji, sehingga memenuhi aturan h. Abstrak tidak menyebut kata pencacahan secara eksplisit.

bukti: This work reviews the development and application of berry harvesting robots with market prospects in recent years.
key technologies of berry picking robots, including fruit detection and localization technology, motion planning technology, and end-effector and harvesting mechanism
catatan: Tinjauan robot pemanen beri. Deteksi dan lokalisasi buah dibahas hanya sebagai komponen pemetikan, tanpa pencacahan atau estimasi hasil, sehingga dikecualikan menurut aturan h.

yang_dicoba: OpenAlex (abstrak kosong); Semantic Scholar (abstrak null); Crossref (tanpa abstrak); WebSearch judul persis
bukti: [parafrasa web] Tinjauan sensor fleksibel, serat optik, biosensor, dan elektrokimia di rantai pasok buah: prediksi kematangan, residu pestisida, kesegaran saat penyimpanan dan transportasi, kerusakan mekanis.
catatan: Tinjauan teknologi sensor pascapanen dan rantai pasok; bukan pencitraan buah di pohon untuk pencacahan. Abstrak verbatim tidak tersedia, bukti berupa parafrasa hasil penelusuran web.

bukti: in this work, the research outputs from the past few years are summarized in the domain of grapevine disease detection
catatan: Tinjauan deteksi penyakit tanaman anggur dari citra udara jarak dekat; objeknya bukan buah.

yang_dicoba: OpenAlex (DOI tidak terdaftar); doi.org (galat server); WebSearch judul persis (tidak menemukan rekaman ini)
catatan: Abstrak tidak ditemukan. Judul dan nama jurnal (Packaging and Food Machinery) menunjukkan tinjauan uji mutu buah tak merusak dengan spektroskopi dan pencitraan NIR, yaitu konteks pascapanen. Teks utama kemungkinan bukan bahasa Inggris.

bukti: the urgent need for fast and non-destructive techniques thus motivated this review
our first aim was to summarize the current knowledge regarding applying spectroscopies, imaging analyses, and other non-destructive techniques to olives and EVOO
catatan: Tinjauan penilaian mutu buah zaitun dan minyak zaitun; tidak membahas deteksi, pencacahan, atau estimasi hasil buah di pohon.

bukti: exploring the potential of fluorescence imaging for non-destructive assessment of agricultural product quality attributes
showcased the application of fluorescence imaging in detecting peel defects in a diverse range of citrus
catatan: Tinjauan pencitraan fluoresensi untuk penyortiran dan mutu produk pascapanen.

bukti: We present an approach to simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) for RGB-D cameras like the Microsoft Kinect.
Our system concurrently estimates the trajectory of a hand-held Kinect and generates a dense 3D model of the environment.
catatan: Makalah metode di luar pertanian: RGB-D SLAM yang menghasilkan model 3D padat (rekonstruksi 3D), relevan dengan asosiasi geometris M4. Bila putaran pertama membatasi T pada metode yang lebih dekat dengan pencacahan, rekaman ini dapat ditinjau ulang.

bukti: we introduce an end-to-end trainable deep architecture that combines features obtained using multiple receptive field sizes
This yields an algorithm that outperforms state-of-the-art crowd counting methods, especially when perspective effects are strong.
catatan: Makalah metode pencacahan objek (kerumunan, peta kepadatan) di luar pertanian.

bukti: We introduce a new large scale unconstrained crowd counting dataset (JHU-CROWD++) that contains "4,372" images with "1.51 million" annotations.
we propose a novel crowd counting network that progressively generates crowd density maps via residual error estimation
catatan: Dataset dan metode pencacahan objek (kerumunan) di luar pertanian.

bukti: we propose a Domain Guided Dropout algorithm to improve the feature learning procedure
Our methods on the person re-identification problem outperform stateof-the-art methods on multiple datasets by large margins.
catatan: Makalah metode re-identifikasi orang di luar pertanian; relevan dengan pencocokan penampilan (M2).
